title: Procedural Timeframes and Documentation
summary: This thread covers the evolution of procedural deadlines and record-keeping requirements, specifically regarding the amendment of certificates and the review of administrative rulings.

evolution.procedure: Shifted from short-term operational amendments (10 days) to more formal administrative review processes (60 days).

timeline.change: Established a 10-day window for amending certificates.
Established a 60-day window for filing and disposing of administrative review applications.

Certificate of Inspection: The issuing inspection agency is authorized to amend a previously issued certificate of inspection if necessary.
Amendments must be made within a specified timeframe of working days after initial issuance and must be completed before the filing of the bill of entry.
The amended certificate must clearly state that it is a revised document and must include the reference number and date of the original certificate.
The inspection agency is required to notify all relevant stakeholders regarding the issuance of any such amended certificate.
Bill of Entry: The submission of a bill of entry serves as a strict procedural deadline before which any necessary amendments to the certificate of inspection must be finalized.

১৪। অগ্রিম রুলিং এর রিভিউ।— (১) বিধি ৯ এর অধীন জারীকৃত অগ্রিম রুলিং অথবা বিধি ১৩ এর অধীন রুলিং এর সংশোধন, রদ বা বাতিল বিষয়ক সিদ্ধান্তে রুলিংধারী সংক্ষুব্ধ হইলে অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিটের নিকট উক্ত সিদ্ধান্ত রিভিউ এর জন্য লিখিতভাবে আবেদন করিতে পারিবে।
(২) রিভিউ এর আবেদন রুলিং প্রাপ্তির বা, ক্ষেত্রমত, রুলিং এর সংশোধন, রদ বা বাতিলের বিষয়ে অবহিত হইবার, তারিখ হইতে ৬০ (ষাট) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে দাখিল করিতে হইবে, এবং উহাতে উক্তরূপ আবেদনের যৌক্তিকতা সবিস্তারে উল্লেখ করিতে হইবে।
(৩) অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট রিভিউ আবেদন প্রাপ্তির ৬০ (ষাট) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে উহা নিষ্পত্তি করিবে।

Advance Ruling: An applicant who is aggrieved by a decision concerning the issuance, amendment, revocation, or cancellation of an advance ruling may file a written application for a review of that decision.

The application for review must be submitted within a specified timeframe following the date the decision was received or the notification of the amendment, revocation, or cancellation was issued, and it must include a detailed justification for the request.
Advance Ruling Unit: The Advance Ruling Unit acts as the authority to which an aggrieved party submits a formal written request for the review of previous decisions made regarding advance rulings.
The unit is mandated to dispose of and finalize any received review application within a prescribed maximum period of working days from the date of receipt.
